name: GitHub Docs
body: A content security policy that starts from default-src 'none', HSTS, nosniff, and framing limited to its own origin. But none of the 20 pages analyzed has a canonical link, so URL variants compete in search.
lesson: Add a self-referencing canonical to every docs page. Versioned and translated docs need it most.
summary: docs.github.com scores 91 out of 100 (A). 0 checks fail now, 13 are at risk, and 20 pass. Fix first: 20 language alternate problems.

fix.title: 20 language alternate problems
fix.evidence: /en has no self reference, /en/get-started has no self reference, /en/migrations has no self reference and 17 more.
fix.fix: Each language version must list every version, itself included, and each must link back.

fix.title: 20 pages have no canonical link
fix.evidence: /en, /en/get-started, /en/migrations, /en/account-and-profile and 16 more. Without it, tracking parameters and trailing slashes can split ranking signals.
fix.fix: Add <link rel="canonical" href="…"> with the page's own https URL.

fix.title: Permissions-Policy is not sent
fix.evidence: Embedded content can ask for the camera, microphone, or location. Missing on all 20 pages analyzed.

fix.title: No Organization or Person entity describes who is behind the site
fix.evidence: AI answers lean on this to name the brand, its logo, and its profiles. The page links 12 profiles that could go in sameAs.
fix.fix: Add Organization (or Person) JSON-LD with name, url, logo, and sameAs. The fix kit has a draft.

fix.title: No sitemap was found
fix.evidence: robots.txt names no sitemap and /sitemap.xml returned 404.
fix.fix: Publish /sitemap.xml and add a Sitemap: line to robots.txt.

fix.title: 7 HTML documents are heavier than 500 KB
fix.fix: Move inline data and SVG out of the HTML.

works.title: Every internal link that was opened answered
AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page
Plain http redirects permanently to https
Every image has an alt attribute
The start page arrived in 114 ms
Every page has a meta description
